site.sitedescription: Croton Springs lies near the northwest margin of Willcox Playa. Regional vegetation is desert grassland of Aristida, Hilaria, Bouteloua, and Sporobolus, with Yucca, Opuntia, Gutierrezia, Haplopappus, Ephedra, and Prosopis.
